description: Delete a calendar event you own, such as a personal event. Cannot be undone. Course events return a permission error. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

name: delete_calendar_event
title: Delete Calendar Event
